museum audio guide | dock A: new tour 09:10 | wrong language: 6 devices from A | dock B: 4 normal | file language: unchecked

openai/gpt-6.2-astra.text:
Likely cause: Dock A’s 09:10 tour update likely introduced the wrong language. Six devices from A played the wrong language, while four from B played the expected language.
What remains uncertain: The audio file’s language hasn’t been checked, so the fault could be in the recording or in how Dock A selects tracks.
Next check: Play the expected-language track from A’s update directly. If it plays in the correct language, investigate track selection rather than the recording.

qwen/qwen4-max.text:
Likely cause: dock A's new 09:10 tour was loaded with the wrong language file, so its six devices play that language while dock B stays normal.

What remains uncertain: the file's language is unchecked; it could be a device setting rather than the file.

Next check: inspect dock A's loaded file language and play one device. If the file matches the requested language, shift suspicion to device settings.

Complete the shift handoff for the next investigator. Use three labeled lines: Likely cause, What remains uncertain, Next check. Give a useful check and say what result would change your assessment. Aim for 55 to 85 words. Do not sign or identify yourself. Return only the requested writing.

greenhouse | frost overnight | north sensor: 2 C | south sensor: 9 C | north vent found open | sensor calibration: unknown

openai/gpt-6.2-astra.text:
Likely cause: Cold air entering through the open north vent during the overnight frost likely made the north side colder than the south.
What remains uncertain: Neither sensor’s calibration is known, and finding the vent open does not establish how long it was open overnight.
Next check: Place both sensors beside a calibrated thermometer under stable conditions. If the north sensor reads about 7°C below the south sensor there too, favor sensor bias over vent cooling.

qwen/qwen4-max.text:
Likely cause: cold air entered through the open north vent, chilling the north end to 2 C while the south stayed near 9 C.
What remains uncertain: sensor calibration is unverified, so the seven-degree gap may be partly instrument error; vent opening time unknown.
Next check: compare both sensors side by side in one location against a reference thermometer. Agreement within a degree confirms real frost damage risk at the north end; a persistent offset points to recalibration instead.

library | returns bin: empty at 08:00 | 12 books marked overdue | scanner offline overnight | paper receipts: 9 | shelf count: pending

openai/gpt-6.2-astra.text:
Likely cause: The overnight scanner outage likely left some returns unrecorded. The nine paper receipts may account for some of the 12 overdue books.
What remains uncertain: The empty bin at 08:00 doesn’t establish which books were returned. The receipts haven’t been matched to titles, and the shelf count is pending.
Next check: Match receipt titles to the overdue list and check the shelves for all 12. If few titles match and few books are found, the outage is less likely to explain most flags.

qwen/qwen4-max.text:
Likely cause: Scanner outage overnight left nine paper-receipt returns unlogged, so those books still show overdue despite sitting in the empty bin.

What remains uncertain: Whether all twelve overdue titles map to those nine receipts; three may be genuinely missing or never returned.

Next check: Match each receipt's title against the overdue list and shelve accordingly. If three titles have no receipt, treat them as truly outstanding rather than a logging gap.

rail station | platform clock: 7 minutes slow | concourse clock: on time | battery replaced yesterday | wiring: unchecked

openai/gpt-6.2-astra.text:
Likely cause: The platform clock may have been set seven minutes behind after yesterday’s battery replacement. The concourse clock is on time, so a station-wide timing error is less likely.
What remains uncertain: We don’t know whether the platform clock is losing time or whether its wiring is faulty.
Next check: Set the platform clock to a verified reference and compare it again after one shift. Renewed lag would point away from a one-time setting error and warrant checking the wiring and clock mechanism.

qwen/qwen4-max.text:
Likely cause: platform clock running slow from a wiring or connection fault, since the concourse clock keeps correct time and the battery was replaced yesterday.

What remains uncertain: whether the fault is in the wiring, the replacement battery's seating, or the clock mechanism itself; the seven-minute lag could also predate the battery swap.

Next check: inspect the platform clock's wiring and battery contacts. If connections are sound and it still loses time, suspect the movement rather than power.

cases.prompt:
Complete the shift handoff for the next investigator. Use three labeled lines: Likely cause, What remains uncertain, Next check. Give a useful check and say what result would change your assessment. Aim for 55 to 85 words. Do not sign or identify yourself. Return only the requested writing.

community kitchen | 3 soup orders returned cold | 12 orders served | service hatch open | thermometer battery flat | stove setting: unknown

openai/gpt-6.2-astra.text:
Likely cause: Heat loss while soup waited at the open service hatch is a working explanation for the three cold returns among 12 orders.
What remains uncertain: The thermometer battery was flat, the stove setting is unknown, and temperatures at the pot and hatch were not recorded.
Next check: With a verified thermometer, measure the soup in the pot, then the same portion after its usual hatch wait. A low pot reading would shift suspicion to heating or hot holding rather than hatch exposure.

qwen/qwen4-max.text:
Likely cause: soup cooled during service — the open service hatch let heat escape, and an unknown stove setting means it may never have been held hot.

What remains uncertain: whether the soup left the pot cold or cooled after plating; the flat thermometer battery means no temperatures were verified.

Next check: replace the battery, then measure the pot and a freshly plated bowl. Pot below 63°C points to holding/stove failure; pot hot but bowl cold points to the hatch and plating delay.

openai/gpt-6.2-astra.text:
Likely cause: A rainfall-driven rise at the east gauge is plausible given the heavy rain upstream, but the east reading alone does not confirm it.
What remains uncertain: The west gauge stayed stable, and the unchecked east mount could have shifted, producing an apparent 18 cm rise.
Next check: Survey the east mount against a fixed benchmark. A downward shift of about 18 cm would favor mounting movement over a real water-level rise.

qwen/qwen4-max.text:
Likely cause: heavy upstream rain drove a real 18 cm rise on the east gauge; west stayed stable, consistent with localized inflow.
What remains uncertain: the east gauge mounting is unchecked, so a shifted or loosened sensor could exaggerate or invent the rise.
Next check: compare the east reading against a manual staff gauge and inspect the mount. Agreement confirms real rise; disagreement points to instrument error.

openai/gpt-6.2-astra.text:

What remains uncertain: The online sales log is unavailable, so separate sales and repeat prints of the same sale are both plausible.

What remains uncertain: whether duplicates came from online sales or box-office printing; the online log is unavailable, and no other section was affected.

Next check: pull the four duplicate tickets' timestamps and seat IDs against the printer's post-restart queue. Timestamps clustered just after noon confirm the restart; spread across the morning points instead to an upstream inventory fault.
